description: This file defines template classes for managing web transfer operations, including client and server transfer types, within a Web namespace. It includes classes for handling transfer states, link management, hash calculation, and request/response processing, specifically for WebTransfer functionality in a web-based communication framework.

classes.name: SingleElementFactoryType
classes.description: A template class that manages a singleton element of type ELEMENT, providing access via the Element() method.

classes.name: ClientTransferType
classes.description: A template class managing client-side web transfer operations, including state management, request handling, hash calculation, and transfer control for upload/download operations.

classes.name: ServerTransferType
classes.description: A template class managing server-side web transfer operations, handling incoming requests, authorization, file storage, and response generation.

methods.name: StartTransfer
methods.description: Initiates a transfer with a given request.

methods.name: CollectInfo
methods.description: Collects information about a source URL.

methods.name: Upload
methods.description: Uploads a file to a destination URL.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Downloads a file from a source URL to a destination file.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Virtual method to set up remote URL, to be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: InfoCollected
methods.description: Virtual method called when info collection is complete.

methods.name: Transferred
methods.description: Virtual method called when transfer is complete.

methods.name: Authorize
methods.description: Virtual method to authorize a request, to be implemented by derived classes.
